# DEMOCRATS CONTROL THE HOUSE BY 40; Early Returns Indicate a Political Overturn for the Sixty-Second Congress.

Nov. 9, 1910

Credit... The New York Times Archives

Occasionally the digitization process introduces transcription errors or other problems; we are continuing to work to improve these archived versions.

The Democratic wave that swept all over the country puts the Republicans out of the control of the lower House of Congress, which they have weld for fifteen years, and gives the Democrats a majority on the early returns of about 40 in the Sixty-second Congress. Their gains were heaviest in New York, where they cleaned the Republicans out of Manhattan, took more of their districts in Brooklyn, gathered in Col.
